description:
`Filament.VNodeCompiler` currently produces code that constructs `%Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{}` structs at runtime. Switch the codegen target to vnode tuples — `{:element, "div", [...attrs...], [...children...]}`, `{:component, Mod, props, key}`, `{:text, value}`, `{:fragment, [...]}`.

## Semantics that must map cleanly to vnode IR

- Lexical `@`-variable scoping (Item 1a from flm-40e).
- Reactive scope inference / auto-memoization (Item 1b from flm-40e).
- `:for` + `:key` keyed comprehensions, with the existing `hoist_comprehension_handlers` passes adapted for vnode-emitting bodies. (The recent compiler hoisting fix's intent is preserved: `component_keyed` calls don't sit inside lazy entry fns; substrate-side eager evaluation.)
- Event-handler registration (`event_at` calls) firing eagerly during the substrate walk, not via `Safe.to_iodata` coercion. The `Renderer.render/3` flow no longer relies on `Safe.to_iodata` to drive side effects.
- Colocated hooks.

PLV's `Tokenizer` remains the upstream parser for `~F`'s HTML-like syntax. The change is in what the post-parse AST passes lower into.

## Files

- `lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex` (largest change).
- `lib/filament/sigil_f.ex` (potentially).
- `lib/filament/tag_engine.ex` (`component`/`component_keyed` calling-convention shift).

## Tests touched

- `test/filament/vnode_compiler_test.exs`
- `test/filament/sigil_f_phase1_test.exs`
- `test/filament/sigil_f_phase2_test.exs`
- Keyed-comprehension reconciler tests
- Colocated-hook tests
- Memoization tests

## Acceptance

- `~F"..."` evaluates to a vnode tree (or a closure returning one).
- Keyed reconciliation works (todo example, `:for` + `:key` case).
- Memoization tests pass.
- Colocated-hook tests pass.
- No `%Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{}` constructed by compiler-emitted code.
title: Phase 1.4: ~F codegen target switch
